reviewer_role: Independent of author. Personally read all complete actual source units, retained target passages, necessary context, and each complete source-target-category-rationale triple in this turn. No reading or semantic approval is inherited from author flags.
review_method: Fresh independent complete_text reads through show-triples.py in unclipped batches 1-33, 34-67, 68-104, 105-135, and 136-174. This personally read all 147 supported source units, every retained complete target passage, every category, and every full rationale. Separately read 27:32 within 27:31-34 to cover all 148 actual source units. Read all three unresolved candidate passages and the listed necessary contexts. Then independently reread all eight exact refinement-stage old triples and all seven replacement complete triples, including the removed 26:29 to 23:12 pair. Scrutinized same-chapter relationships for actual heading membership, demonstrative or pronoun antecedents, sentence continuation, stated roster summaries, or specific narrative/prayer connections. Preserved supplied names, roles, quantities, unusual grammar, and variant account details. No forced personal identity, ceremony chronology, or numerical reconciliation is accepted.
pin_method: Adapted the packet pin-fetch script with a unique peer-independent prefix and executed a fresh download for each of the eight used books at the immutable source commit. Independently verified the fetched Git blob SHA1 against fixed source-check registry identities, computed raw SHA256, saved separate raw artifacts, and compared each entire parsed cache with its fetched pinned file. At receipt freeze rehashed each saved raw artifact, recomputed its Git blob identity, and rechecked whole parsed-cache equality through pin_artifact_contract. Author raw files and receipts were not altered.

Accept removal of this drafted inference; retain only the separately supported scribal/judicial service comparison to 23:4.

semantic_review_notes: The 25:9 first/second-lot wording, twenty-four musical course entries, named family rosters, and larger service totals are preserved. Heading links state the specific musical or gatekeeper scope rather than infer personal identities.

The Rosai wording, Osa sentence divided across 26:10-11, gate-location and staffing continuations, and 27:34 counselor wording remain as supplied. These links use actual sentence structure without supplying absent names or repairing the text.

Explicit name-plus-kinship or name-plus-locality comparisons are bounded to the stated relation. Achitophel/Ahithophel is compared through the royal counselor setting while preserving both forms. The three unresolved candidate equations remain pending outside retained pairs.

The seven retained author refinements are warranted: Aiman is the player in 25:5; 22:9 supplies Solomon's name; 28:7 reports a divine promise; 22:14 gives metal quantities; 29:3 does not establish public ownership of earlier preparations; Exodus 35:27 concerns sacred work; and the accession notice does not resolve distinct ceremony chronology.

Actual supplied 1 Kings 7:34-37 units support the temple-furnishing links. Exodus 25:2-9 contains the extant units and does not introduce a missing verse 6. Singular/plural furnishing counts, gold/silver distinctions, and David's seven years versus Samuel's seven years six months remain distinct.
